name: API Success vs Failure Rate
description: 2-minute timeshift delta of api_success_count and api_failure_count.
programText:
raw_a = data('kafka_schema_registry_api_success_count_api_success_count', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'schemaregistry') and filter('service.instance.id', 'schemaregistry-0'))
((raw_a - raw_a.timeshift('2m')) / 120).publish(label='Success')
raw_b = data('kafka_schema_registry_api_failure_count_api_failure_count', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'schemaregistry') and filter('service.instance.id', 'schemaregistry-0'))
((raw_b - raw_b.timeshift('2m')) / 120).publish(label='Failure')
